page.overview:
What is Phantom Animatronics?

The Phantom animatronics are hallucination variants of the Classic, Withered, and Toy animatronics who haunt the security guard of Fazbear's Fright: The Horror Attraction throughout the week.

The Phantom animatronics first appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's 3 as the secondary antagonists. They returned in Ultimate Custom Night (with the exception of Phantom Foxy and Phantom Puppet) and Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted (with the exception of Phantom Chica and Phantom Puppet).

The Phantom animatronics are burnt and damaged ghost-like entities based on the animatronics from the first two games, with greenish hues and charred colors. Their dark color tones make these variants almost blend in with the backgrounds, as well as making them hardly noticeable, especially when viewing the security cameras. All of the Phantom animatronics have empty black eyes with grayish-colored irises and glowing white pupils.

The Phantoms originate in the player's mind due to lack of air from ventilation and the creepy atmosphere of Fazbear's Fright. They will appear at random on certain cameras or simply in the office. If one is to witness a Phantom they will jumpscare the player, but due to being hallucinations, they are non-lethal, before disappearing in a flash of light to either disable their ventilation or merely act as distractions which makes it harder to keep track of Springtrap.
